Our Story

From Ammamma's Kitchen to Yours

Every jar, every pack, every batter carries the warmth of home-cooked food. We started Ammamma's in 2019 with a simple mission — to bring the authentic taste of traditional Indian kitchens to modern homes, without compromises.

About Ammamma's

Ammamma's brings you authentic Indian foods — pickles, spice powders, chapatis, parotas & more. Made with love since 2019.

What started as a small kitchen experiment has grown into a beloved brand that brings the taste of grandmother's cooking to homes across India.

Spiced Paneer Chapati Wraps

Quick wraps using soft chapatis filled with spiced paneer and mint chutney.

Prep: 10 min Cook: 10 min 2 servings Easy

Ingredients

  • 4 Ammamma's Whole Wheat Chapatis
  • 200g paneer cubed
  • 1 bell pepper sliced
  • 1 onion sliced
  • 1 tsp cumin powder
  • ½ tsp garam masala
  • ½ tsp red chilli powder
  • Salt to taste
  • 2 tbsp mint chutney
  • 1 tbsp oil

Instructions

  1. 1

    Sauté onion and bell pepper.

  2. 2

    Add paneer with spices, toss 3 minutes.

  3. 3

    Warm chapatis on tawa.

  4. 4

    Spread chutney, add filling.

  5. 5

    Roll tightly, cut and serve.

Pro Tips

  • • Add cheese for fusion twist.
  • • Swap paneer for chicken or tofu.
  • • Great for lunchboxes.

Egg Kothu Parota

Popular street-food — soft parotas torn and tossed with spiced scrambled eggs.

Prep: 10 min Cook: 10 min 2 servings Easy

Ingredients

  • 4 Ammamma's Malabar Parotas
  • 3 eggs
  • 1 large onion
  • 2 green chillies
  • Curry leaves
  • 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste
  • ½ tsp red chilli powder
  • ¼ tsp turmeric
  • Salt to taste
  • 2 tbsp oil

Instructions

  1. 1

    Heat parotas on tawa. Tear into pieces.

  2. 2

    Sauté curry leaves, chillies, and onion.

  3. 3

    Add ginger-garlic paste, cook 1 minute.

  4. 4

    Scramble eggs with turmeric and chilli powder.

  5. 5

    Add torn parota pieces and toss on high heat.

  6. 6

    Season and serve hot.

Pro Tips

  • • Add your favourite pickle for spicier version.
  • • Squeeze lemon before serving.
  • • Works great with leftover parotas.

Prep: 10 min Cook: 20 min 4 servings Medium

Ingredients

  • 500g Ammamma's Poori Dough
  • 3 potatoes boiled and cubed
  • 1 onion chopped
  • 1 tomato chopped
  • 1 tsp mustard seeds
  • ½ tsp turmeric
  • 1 tsp Sambar Powder
  • Curry leaves
  • Oil for frying
  • Salt to taste

Instructions

  1. 1

    Heat oil, add mustard seeds and curry leaves.

  2. 2

    Add onion, sauté until soft.

  3. 3

    Add tomato, turmeric, sambar powder.

  4. 4

    Add potatoes, water, simmer 5 min.

  5. 5

    Roll dough into circles, deep fry until puffy.

  6. 6

    Serve hot with curry.

Pro Tips

  • • Oil should be hot enough for poori to rise in 3 seconds.
  • • Don't roll too thin.
  • • Add spice mix for extra depth.
